summary:
Rocket Detective is an educational web application that turns space mission design into an interactive detective-style game.
Players take on the role of engineers investigating problems with rockets and spacecraft. By examining design data, collecting evidence, and testing hypotheses, they must identify the root causes of failures and find ways to improve the designs within a limited budget.
Unlike conventional design simulations, Rocket Detective focuses on the process of investigation and problem-solving rather than simply choosing components. Players learn how factors such as fuel, thrust, and spacecraft structure affect mission performance through trial and error.
Through this game, we hope players will become curious about how rockets and spacecraft work. By investigating problems and trying different solutions, players can experience some of the challenges engineers face when designing space missions.
details:
1. How It Works and Its Features

Rocket Detective is an educational web game that introduces the basics of rocket engineering through detective-style investigations.

Players examine a rocket design, review evidence, and form hypotheses to identify technical problems. They then improve the design by adjusting components within a limited budget and check whether it meets the mission requirements.

The game also includes a Japanese-English language switch and a "Science Notes" feature explaining concepts such as thrust, specific impulse, and the rocket equation.

2. Benefits and Intended Impact

The game allows beginners to learn basic space engineering concepts through hands-on problem-solving. Players experience the importance of balancing factors such as budget, fuel, thrust, and spacecraft structure.

Our goal is to make space exploration more accessible and encourage students and beginners to develop an interest in space science and engineering.

3. Tools and Technologies Used

・HTML and CSS: Creating the web pages and interface.
・JavaScript: Implementing game features and evaluations.
・Visual Studio Code: Developing the program.
・GitHub and GitHub Pages: Managing and publishing the project.
・ChatGPT: Supporting idea development, code generation, debugging, and game design.

The project was developed using a personal computer, without specialized hardware.

4. Creativity and Design Approach

Unlike ordinary component-selection games, Rocket Detective focuses on investigation and problem-solving. Players must identify the cause of a problem before changing the design.

A limited budget and multiple evaluation factors encourage players to consider trade-offs rather than simply choosing the highest-performing components.

The game uses simplified fictional evaluation values for educational purposes. It does not simulate actual rocket performance or orbital trajectories.

5. Factors Considered by the Team

We focused on accessibility for beginners, scientific learning, engaging gameplay, and development feasibility.

The project was developed through discussions between two team members, with one member primarily responsible for implementation. ChatGPT was used extensively to support coding and development. The team decided on the project direction and reviewed, tested, and adjusted the generated code.
